steps.say: Prism Scan runs a Set across your assets, and can keep watching for you.
Open Prism Scan. | Your Sets are on the left, with Angstrom's examples, grouped by trading idea.
Tap plus on Dip in my uptrend. | A new scan starts, on your whole watchlist.
Press play to run it now, on the latest finished candles.
Each asset gets Yes, No, or Unknown, with the reason beside it.
To keep watching, give the scan a schedule. | Here, at every daily close.
And choose where its alerts go: in the app, by email, or both.
Your scan now checks every day by itself, and tells you when an answer turns to Yes.
